scoring_justification: Cannot recompute N_EF and gamma from raw DFT log; instead compare reported values to paper gold with tolerance and verify internal consistency (gamma from N_EF).

hidden_assets.purpose: N(E_F) and gamma gold values from the paper's electronic structure calculation
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Electronic Structure section: N(E_F)=1.35 states/(eV cell), gamma=3.18 mJ/(mol K^2)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly extracted from the paper text
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported computed quantities; used as reference to verify agent reproduction.

N_EF.description: Total density of states at the Fermi energy, in states per eV per unit cell

gamma.description: Electronic specific heat coefficient, in mJ/(mol K^2)

outputs.description: Electronic structure properties of stoichiometric MoB2 computed with DFT-LDA: the total density of states at the Fermi level N(EF) and the electronic specific heat coefficient γ.

output_contract.notes: The scoring compares N_EF and γ to the paper-reported reference values within a relative tolerance. The DFT code must use LDA pseudopotentials, the correct AlB2 structure, and the specified lattice parameters.

steps.description: Recompute gamma from N_EF using γ = (π²/3) k_B² N_EF (converted to mJ/(mol K^2)) and check consistency with the agent's reported gamma.
Check N_EF is within 10% of the paper's reported value (1.35 states/(eV cell)).
Check gamma is within 10% of the paper's reported value (3.18 mJ/(mol K^2)).
